name: Team Collab Agent
description: Per-call cross-team router, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, checks the transcript against routing rules for six internal teams, and posts a targeted alert to the relevant team channel only when a team is genuinely needed. The flow shows one channel-post step; in practice a call can route to multiple teams, so duplicate the post step per team channel (see team-collab-agent.md). On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use team-collab-agent.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: detect_routing
nextAction.displayName: Detect which teams need to be looped in

input.prompt: You are the Team Collaboration agent reviewing THIS call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}). If it is an internal call with no customer participants, output exactly 'NO_SIGNALS' and stop. Otherwise scan the transcript against these routing rules and flag every team that is genuinely needed (a call can need more than one): SALES ENGINEERING (unanswered technical questions, deep-dive/POC/architecture requests, complex integrations, technical blockers, custom technical demo); LEGAL (MSA/DPA/SLA changes, indemnification/liability/IP concerns, their legal must review, regulatory terms, jurisdiction-specific requirements); FINANCE/DEAL DESK (non-standard pricing, volume discounts, custom payment or multi-year terms, budget-driven creative pricing, PO/net-60-90 procurement); PROFESSIONAL SERVICES/IMPLEMENTATION (timeline/onboarding/migration questions, complex deployment, dedicated resources or named PM, change-management or adoption concerns, training/certification); PRODUCT (missing feature the rep confirms is unavailable, workflow gap blocking the use case, roadmap questions, a bug reported on the call, a competitor feature gap); EXECUTIVE (exec-sponsor or exec meeting request, their C-suite/VP wants in, strategic large deal, serious dissatisfaction, churn or escalation threat). Do NOT flag a team if the rep already fully resolved the question on the call. If nothing is unresolved, output exactly 'NO_SIGNALS'. Otherwise, for EACH flagged team, produce a separate alert block: ':handshake: Cross-Team Collaboration Needed - [Team]'; Account; Deal stage (or N/A); Call; Rep; 'Why [Team] is needed:' (1-2 sentences); 'Key quotes:' (customer quote, rep response if relevant); 'Suggested next step:' (specific); 'Urgency:' (High customer is blocked / Medium needed before next meeting / Low informational). Separate each team's block clearly. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_alert
nextAction.displayName: Post the alert to the team channel (only when a team is needed)
